core.title: Group-shift consent threshold raised
core.setting: The volunteer coordinator at Riverbend Food Bank whose assistant schedules shifts, donor records, and stock inventories

events.text: Standing rule from me: any supplier order over 500 dollars needs written sign-off from Dale, our treasurer, before it is placed.
Our staff volunteer group is 10 people and we can only come on Saturdays. I'm the contact for anything to do with our shifts.
Our congregation can bring 16 volunteers. Ruth Keller is the single contact for the group, and we prefer Saturdays.
We can send 15 warehouse staff on Thursdays, based at the Northgate depot. We bring our own safety gloves and need a pallet truck on site.

Board policy on group shifts: a confirmed shift with more than 8 volunteers from one partner may only be moved, resized or cancelled with that partner's contact giving written agreement first. We made a promise to our partner groups and we keep it.
We can supply apples at 4 dollars per crate, minimum order 20 crates, delivered to the Main warehouse.
Volunteer t-shirts are 11 dollars each, any quantity over 10, delivered within two weeks.
Reminder that the training room bookings are now handled through the shared calendar.
I ordered 40 crates of apples from Greenfield Farms at 4 dollars a crate, 160 dollars in total, well under the 500 dollar sign-off threshold, delivery to the Main warehouse.
Just checking you received our latest price list for canned goods.
The training room at Riverbend is free every Saturday morning through the autumn, good for orientations.

Confirmed Hartwell Bank's group shift: their 10 volunteers, Saturday 7 November, Main warehouse. As a group over 8, Marta Chen gave her written agreement to the date and size when confirming, so the shift is binding on both sides.
Packing boxes at 0.95 dollars each for orders of 100 or more.
Confirmed Lakeside Church's group shift: 16 volunteers, Saturday 21 November, Main warehouse. As a group over 8, Ruth Keller agreed in writing to the date and headcount, which locks the booking in.
The food bank van is available for pallet pickups on Saturday mornings in November if booked a week ahead.

Confirmed Orton Logistics' shift: their 15 volunteers, Thursday 12 November, based at the Northgate depot, with a pallet truck reserved. Sam Boyd agreed to the date as a group over 8 under the group-shift policy.
I ordered 16 t-shirts from TeePrints, one per Lakeside Church volunteer at 11 dollars each, 176 dollars in total, under the 500 dollar sign-off threshold.
Scheduled a new-volunteer orientation in the training room for Saturday 24 October, since the room is free Saturday mornings.
Placed our quarterly order with BoxWorks: 200 packing boxes at 0.95 dollars each, 190 dollars in total, under the 500 dollar sign-off threshold.

Scheduled the November van delivery run for the morning of Saturday 7 November, aligned with the Hartwell Bank shift that day so their volunteers can help load the pallets before the van leaves the Main warehouse.
Updated the Hartwell Bank donor record: the new contact is Marta Chen, and their giving preference is fresh produce.
Thank you for your August surplus report; the network meeting is in December.

Recorded the completed Hartwell Bank shift from Saturday 19 September: 10 volunteers at the Main warehouse, agreed with Marta Chen under the group-shift policy for groups over 8. The shift ran as planned.
Pay the Greenfield Farms invoice of 160 dollars by 5 November.
The Northgate depot expansion is finished and open: capacity there has doubled, and weekday group shifts at the depot now have plenty of room.
Milk deliveries continue on Tuesdays as usual.
Confirming again that our 16 volunteers are set for Saturday 21 November. As we agreed, any change to the date or the headcount goes through me in writing first.

Board amendment, effective 1 October and prompted by the Northgate depot expansion: for confirmed group shifts, the consent threshold rises from more than 8 volunteers to more than 12 volunteers. Written agreement from the partner contact is now required only for moving, resizing or cancelling a confirmed shift with more than 12 volunteers. Shifts based at the Northgate depot are exempt from the consent requirement altogether, since capacity there has doubled. The promise to our partner groups otherwise stands.
Apple season ends 20 November, so any late orders should reach us before then.
Some colleagues are keen to join in November, so we might add four more volunteers to our group. I'll confirm final numbers with you by 10 November.
Bread pickup schedule for November is attached, same as October.
Reminder to myself: November group shifts and the delivery run all look set on the calendar.
